root_causes.parameter_note: Illustrative perturbations, not measured FR10 properties: 20 mg at 30 mm; 2 percent of Kms acting at 40 mm; 2 percent of Bl acting at 10 mm.

model_scope: Paper-style feed-forward root-cause separation. Piston response is k=0 full-360 cyclic FEM; rocking compliance is k=1 full-360 cyclic FEM under a normalized coil-distributed moment.
